svg.title: AsterixDB service-based architecture
svg.desc: Service-based architecture for AsterixDB: Cluster Controller coordinates jobs and cluster state; Node Controllers execute query fragments, manage local storage, and run runtime operators; platform services include query compilation, metadata management, ingestion, transaction handling, and storage management.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do clients submit queries to AsterixDB?')

g.text: Coordinates jobs · cluster state · query dispatch · lifecycle management

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the AsterixDB query compiler do?')
sendPrompt('What does the AsterixDB metadata service manage?')
sendPrompt('What does the AsterixDB transaction manager handle?')
sendPrompt('How does the Cluster Controller dispatch jobs to Node Controllers?')
g.text: Split query plan into job fragments · dispatch to Node Controllers · collect results
Node Controllers — worker services (one per node)
Execute query fragments · manage local storage · run runtime operators

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does a Node Controller do in AsterixDB?')
sendPrompt('How do multiple Node Controllers parallelize query execution?')
sendPrompt('Can AsterixDB Node Controllers scale horizontally?')
sendPrompt('How does AsterixDB store data locally on each node?')
g.text: LSM-based storage · partitioned datasets · buffer cache · disk files

svg.text: Large distributed database components with clear responsibilities — not microservices, not a monolith
